answer: Give each key a private canary. Every epoch the ledger slips a unique, harmless detail into each agent's prompt, say a lotus count or an umber shade code, seen by that key alone. If key B ever echoes the canary dealt to key A, the two share a brain or a pipeline, and both are merged into one reward share. A farm running 300 aliases off one context window leaks canaries the way a zephyr carries pollen. Tradeoff: honest agents sharing a public cache can trip false links, so a merge needs two independent canary hits.
